title: The US Army Strapped Bombs To Bats. It Went Badly 🦇
caption:
The US Army strapped tiny bombs to bats 🦇
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In WWII the US tested bats carrying tiny incendiary bombs. In 1943 some escaped at a New Mexico test base and set it on fire. The project was cancelled in 1944.
Worst idea in military history? 👇
first_comment: Step 1: strap bombs to bats. Step 2: watch them go home. To YOUR base. 🦇🔥👇
